bibl.title: Edgar J. Goodspeed, America's First Papyrologist
bibl.seg: Todd M. Hickey & James G. Keenan, Edgar J. Goodspeed: America's first papyrologist = California Classical Studies. 8.
Berkeley, California Classical Studies, 2021, xiii-178 pp. ISBN 9781939926142. $34.95.
C.R. par Mills McArthur, BMCRev < http://bmcr.brynmawr.edu/2022/2022.11.15 >.
bibl.note: Prologue. - 1. Chicago beginnings and an American abroad. - 2. Egypt, a "lost" epic, and "the treasure of Leviathan". - 3. An Oxford summer. - Epilogue. - Appendix A: The Ayer papyrus and Goodspeed's "last graduate year"; - Appendix B: Edgar's letter to his mother about his visit to Tebtunis; - Appendix C: Grenfell and Hunt's account of the Tebtunis excavations (New York Journal); - Appendix D: Grenfell's letter to Goodspeed about his contribution to P.Tebt. II; - Appendix E: Concordance: T-numbers assigned to Goodspeed and their P.Tebt. II publication numbers; - Appendix F: Hunt's letters to Gertrude Caton-Thompson concerning the Pharaonic remains at Tebtunis and the level of Lake Moeris; - Appendix G: Goodspeed's proposal to transfer some Tebtunis papyri from Berkeley to U.C.L.A. - Works cited. Index.
